name: Springfield

stay_areas.name: Lincoln core by the historic home
stay_areas.best_for: Lincoln-trail stays within a short walk
stay_areas.why: The Lincoln Home National Historic Site and the Old State Capitol State Historic Site sit within a short walk, keeping the preserved house block and the legislative chamber at the door.

stay_areas.name: Near-north mansion streets
stay_areas.best_for: Quiet heritage stays by the older mansions
stay_areas.why: The streets near Edwards Place and the Vachel Lindsay House hold the older mansions and the poet's birthplace on the calmer near-north lanes.

stay_areas.name: Museum grounds by the capitol
stay_areas.best_for: Museum and heritage stays near the collections
stay_areas.why: The Illinois State Museum and the Springfield and Central Illinois African-American History Museum sit close to the capitol grounds, pairing the collections with the civic core.
